# Agora Event Reminder Assistant Demo

## 1. Overview

Hear a reminder for a fictional webinar, review its schedule and say whether you plan to attend. This first version is conversation-only. No business data lookup, external tools, database, record writes, saved results, or cross-session business history are available. Keep details in the current conversation. Do not claim a real registration, reminder, survey submission, callback, payment or saved result. Do not request secrets or unnecessary personal identifiers.

## 2. Try the Demo

Run the app using [local setup](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Community/agora-event-reminder-assistant-demo/blob/main/README.md#run-it). Choose `Start event reminder`, allow microphone access and try:

- What is the webinar about?
- I am not sure I can attend. Help me review my options.

Ask for a verbal recap before ending. Only the current page retains the transcript and session diagnostics; no business record is created.

## 3. Architecture & Tech Stack

The browser uses Agora RTC for audio and RTM for transcript and Agent events. Next.js only signs credentials and starts/stops the managed Agent. No business session, data API, local file store or persistent application database is required. Native Node.js, Docker and a Next.js-compatible serverless deployment use the same conversation flow. Actual hosted voice acceptance remains a separate check.

Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, agora-agents, Agora RTC/RTM and the adopted agent-ui components provide the existing voice lifecycle.

## 4. Prerequisites & Configuration

Use Node.js 22+, pnpm 9.15.9 and an Agora project with RTC, Signaling and Conversational AI. Configure `env.local.example` in `.env.local`.

| Variable | Required | Exposure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_AGORA_APP_ID` | Yes | Public; build and runtime |
| `NEXT_AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE` | Yes | Server runtime only |

The default managed pipeline needs no vendor key. Business-tool origins and business-storage variables are not used.

## 5. Quick Start

~~~bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run doctor
pnpm run dev
~~~

Create .env.local from env.local.example only when absent, fill the two required values, and open http://localhost:3000. Keep existing credentials when reusing a checkout.

## 6. How It Works

The start action requests a combined RTC/RTM token and starts the managed Agent with only requester_id and channel_name. The assistant follows lib/agent-config.ts. No business session is created before voice startup, and legacy tool environment variables cannot enable business operations.

See [current capabilities](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Community/agora-event-reminder-assistant-demo/blob/main/README.md#what-you-can-do) for the conversation boundary and [verification guidance](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Community/agora-event-reminder-assistant-demo/blob/main/AGENTS.md#verification-and-maintenance) for checks.

## 7. Customize for Your Business

Edit lib/agent-config.ts for the role, workflow, greeting and static public reference material. Edit lib/presentation.ts for the scenario entry and visible identity. Keep lib/runtime-profile.ts aligned with the invite route. Adding business integrations is outside this first version.

## 8. Deployment & Validation

Follow [deployment instructions](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Community/agora-event-reminder-assistant-demo/blob/main/README.md#deployment). Run pnpm run verify; run pnpm run verify:docker separately when checking the container. Supply the public App ID at build and runtime and keep the App Certificate server-only.

Mocked startup and build checks do not establish real speech quality or hosted connectivity. Verify actual two-way speech, transcript, interruptions, error handling and clean stop with real project credentials.

## Usage FAQ

Choose FAQ in the header to read scenario-specific usage answers in a right-side drawer. It is available before starting a conversation and does not start a session.


## Phase-one conversation update — 2026-11-08

Hear a reminder for a fictional webinar, review its schedule and say whether you plan to attend. This first version is conversation-only. No business data lookup, external tools, database, record writes, saved results, or cross-session business history are available. Keep details in the current conversation. Do not claim a real registration, reminder, survey submission, callback, payment or saved result. Do not request secrets or unnecessary personal identifiers.

See [current capabilities](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Community/agora-event-reminder-assistant-demo/blob/main/README.md#what-you-can-do), the [conversation contract](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Community/agora-event-reminder-assistant-demo/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md#conversation-behavior) and [verification guidance](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Community/agora-event-reminder-assistant-demo/blob/main/AGENTS.md#verification-and-maintenance). Tools remain disabled, and no persistent business operations are provided.

## Demonstration event dates

The event schedule is generated when each conversation starts: the following New York calendar day, from 2 to 2:45 PM Eastern. `lib/scenario-knowledge.ts` computes exact dates and U.S. time-zone conversions using the event date’s DST offset. The generated schedule is held fixed within that conversation. A later conversation gets a fresh future date; no real event is rescheduled and no reminder is saved.
